nav.salesChannels.label: Sales channels
actions.openSalesChannels.label: Sales channels
actions.newSalesChannel.label: New sales channel
actions.newSalesChannel.description: Configure a new storefront sales channel
list.page.title: Sales channels
list.page.description: Each channel represents a place of sale (web storefront, marketplace, brick-and-mortar location). Products, customers, prices, and content are scoped to the channels they belong to. The “system default” channel is the implicit fallback for any entity created without explicit channel selection.
list.column.name: Name
list.action.makeDefault.confirm: Make “{code}” the system-default sales channel? Entities created without an explicit channel, and every platform-wide fallback, will point at it from now on. “{previous}” stays exactly as it is and can be made the default again.
list.action.makeDefault.inactiveHelp: An inactive channel cannot become the system default.
list.error.makeDefault: Failed to move the system default.
identity.code.label: Code
identity.code.lockedHelp: A channel code is set once, when the channel is created, and cannot be changed afterwards — deployment configuration, integrations and cached storefront responses all address the channel by it. To correct one, create a channel with the right code and delete this one. The display name stays editable.
identity.name.label: Display name (en-US)
identity.theme.label: Storefront theme
identity.theme.pattern: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter.
identity.theme.help: The theme code the storefront renders this channel in. Leave it empty for the storefront's default theme. Which themes exist is the storefront's answer, not this one's: a code it does not provide renders in the default and is marked on the page as data-theme-requested, and this value is never changed for you.
identity.languages.label: Languages
identity.languages.placeholder: Add a language — search by code or name
identity.languages.help: Active Dictionary languages are available for new selections. Inactive stored values remain visible until removed.
identity.defaultLanguage.label: Default language
identity.defaultLanguage.required: Choose a default language from the selected languages.
identity.currencies.label: Currencies
identity.currencies.placeholder: Add a currency — search by code or name
identity.currencies.help: Active Dictionary currencies are available for new selections. Inactive stored values remain visible until removed.
identity.defaultCurrency.label: Default currency
identity.defaultCurrency.required: Choose a default currency from the selected currencies.
identity.cannotDeactivateDefault: The system-default channel cannot be deactivated.
identity.dictionary.loadError: The Dictionary could not be loaded, so nothing new can be added to the lists below yet. What is already selected is unchanged and can still be saved.
membership.title: Sales channels
membership.empty: This {entityType} is not in any channel. Add at least one to make it visible to a storefront.
errors.INACTIVE_SALES_CHANNEL: This sales channel is inactive. Activate it first.
errors.SALES_CHANNEL_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: This store is available to signed-in customers only. Please sign in.
errors.SALES_CHANNEL_NOT_PERMITTED: This account does not have access to this store.
errors.MISSING_SALES_CHANNEL_CONTEXT: The sales channel for this request could not be determined.
errors.DUPLICATE_SALES_CHANNEL_CODE: A sales channel with this code already exists. Choose a different code.
errors.UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE_CODE: No language with this code was found.
errors.UNKNOWN_CURRENCY_CODE: No currency with this code was found.
errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_SYSTEM_DEFAULT: This is the platform's default sales channel, so it cannot be deactivated or deleted.
errors.SALES_CHANNEL_HAS_ATTRIBUTIONS: Other records are assigned to this sales channel, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.ENTITY_WOULD_HAVE_ZERO_CHANNELS: This change would leave the record without a sales channel, and every record must belong to at least one.
errors.STALE_SALES_CHANNEL_WRITE: Someone else changed this sales channel in the meantime. Reload it and try again.
errors.SALES_CHANNEL_ATTRIBUTION_IMMUTAB: The sales channel a record was created in cannot be changed.
errors.SALES_CHANNEL_CODE_IMMUTABLE: A sales channel code is set when the channel is created and cannot be changed afterwards. Create a channel with the correct code and delete this one instead; the display name stays editable.
identity.anonymousAccess.label: Open to anonymous visitors
identity.anonymousAccess.hint: When off, visitors must sign in, and only customers whose organization is assigned to this channel can use the store. With automatic moderation, anyone who registers a business here gets access.
identity.anonymousAccess.pricesHint: Whether anonymous visitors see prices is a separate setting, the unauthenticated display mode: for every channel in Pricing settings, or for this channel alone on the Settings screen.
identity.prefixDefaultLanguage.label: Prefix the default language in URLs
identity.prefixDefaultLanguage.hint: When on, every storefront address starts with its language, the default one included: /pl/p/drill, /en/p/drill. When off, an address without a language is the default language (/p/drill) and only the other languages are prefixed. Addresses that change keep working through redirects.
identity.prefixDefaultLanguage.urlChange: Changing the channel's languages or this switch changes the storefront's URLs. Old addresses are redirected; browsers may keep a redirect they cached for up to an hour.
